card.description: A dimly lit subterranean chamber carved into basalt, its walls lined with basalt columns etched in ancient Ethiopian hieroglyphs that pulse with bioluminescent light. In the center stands a lone ማእላይት (mediator) in a flowing robe woven from basalt fibers and silver threads, holding a crystalline staff that hums with incomprehensible energy. A central resonator, a lattice of polished obsidian and iridescent crystal, amplifies the chant, projecting glyphs onto the stone walls. The scene blends ancient Ethiopian and Egyptian motifs with advanced, incomprehensible technology, grounded in realism and cinematic photorealism.
visual_anatomy: **Body/Form:** Mediator in a poised stance, robes flowing, crystalline staff in hand, resonator behind, basalt columns surrounding
**Face/Sensors:** Face adorned with glowing glyphs, ocular sensors embedded in silver filaments, subtle bioluminescent veins
**Clothing/Armor:** Basalt-fiber robe with silver-thread embroidery, reinforced with basalt plates, ancient motifs etched in silver
**Key Features:** Bioluminescent glyphs pulsing on walls, crystalline resonator emitting low hum, obsidian lattice, tactile basalt textures
